rule: Each shape has a main colour, a straight colour-4 axis line and one lone colour-4 dot. The dot marks the intact half. The other half is overwritten, across the shape's bounding box and out to the wider half's extent, with the reflection of the intact half. This adds the mirrored dot and clears cells whose partner is background.
scope: Mirror the dot-marked intact half across an accent axis, adding missing cells and clearing damage on the opposite half.
constraints: Read source against archived axis/dot interpretation and executable transform.
Explicit scenes now reject malformed digit patches, disconnected or touching shapes, invalid axes, misplaced dots and nonmajority main colours.

known_limitations: Black background, accent 4, unique main colours and at most four shapes in random mode.
Random axis length at most nine and half-width at most six; damaged side changes by a few edits.

authored_scope: Supported: 1-4 shapes on black grids. Random grids are 10-30 per side, or a requested height/width in 5..30. Main colours are distinct, drawn from {1,2,3,5,6,7,8,9}. The axis is vertical or horizontal, with length 3-9 and at least as long as the shape length minus 3. Either side can be intact. The damaged half is perturbed by 2-5 removals or additions and may be wider or narrower than the intact half. The axis can stop short of the shape ends. Not supported: accent colours other than 4, non-black backgrounds, diagonal axes, multiple dots per shape, touching shapes, or shapes whose half-width exceeds 6.
authored_constraints: Each shape is 8-connected; different shapes' full mirror footprints are separated by at least one background cell, so they are never 8-adjacent and mirroring never writes into another shape.
The main colour strictly outnumbers colour 4 within every shape (main count > axis length + 1).
Axis is a single straight run of length >= 3; the dot sits at distance >= 2 from the axis, so it is never connected to the axis and is the unique smaller accent component.
Exactly one dot per shape, on the intact side; the damaged half never contains colour 4, so the mirrored dot always changes the output (no identity samples).
Damaged half differs from the exact mirror of the intact half's main cells.
Total filled cells <= 45% of grid area.
All loops are bounded; impossible explicit requests raise ValueError instead of silently changing parameters.
